EXPLANATIONS.nominal: The round flew as planned. Nothing to fix.
EXPLANATIONS.ignition: A rough ignition. The igniter needs reworking.
EXPLANATIONS.weld: A tank weld let go under load.
EXPLANATIONS.leak: A propellant leak starved the motor.
EXPLANATIONS.unknown: Not enough evidence. I want another static firing.

weld-fwd.name: Forward tank weld
weld-fwd.sound: The bead is even all the way round.
weld-fwd.cue: A hairline of discolouration runs along part of the seam.

weld-mid.name: Tank girth weld
weld-mid.sound: Clean, regular ripples in the bead.
weld-mid.cue: The bead thins out and there is a pinhole you could miss.

weld-aft.name: Aft tank weld
weld-aft.cue: Spatter and a slight undercut at the edge of the bead.

fitting.name: Acid feed fitting
fitting.sound: Dry to the touch, safety wire in place.
fitting.cue: A faint green stain under the union nut.

pressure.name: Helium pressurisation line
pressure.sound: Tight, no hiss with the line charged.
pressure.cue: You think you hear a faint hiss, but the hangar is noisy.

fins.name: Fin attachment
fins.cue: One fin looks a degree off true by eye.
